B

BulkExporter - Class in org.saidone.protoalf.bulkexporter
Exports the content of a repository folder in the layout read by the Alfresco Bulk Filesystem Import Tool: one file or directory per document or folder, named as in Alfresco; next to each one a <name>.metadata.properties.xml shadow file (Java XML properties) with type, aspects and the properties, names in prefix:local form; the previous versions of a document as <name>.v1, <name>.v2, ... oldest first, with their shadow files <name>.metadata.properties.xml.v1, ...: the file without suffix is the current version.
BulkExporter(Channel, TicketProvider, Duration) - Constructor for class org.saidone.protoalf.bulkexporter.BulkExporter
Creates the standalone exporter with one shared channel, ticket provider and export deadline.
